mapper.select: SELECT id, emp_no, emp_name, password_hash, salt, must_change_password, status, page_permissions, remark, last_login_at, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM cps_admin_user WHERE emp_no = #{empNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, emp_no, emp_name, password_hash, salt, must_change_password, status, page_permissions, remark, last_login_at, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM cps_admin_user WHERE enabled = 1 AND emp_no = #{empNo} AND emp_name = #{empName} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, emp_no, emp_name, password_hash, salt, must_change_password, status, page_permissions, remark, last_login_at, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM cps_admin_user ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_admin_user (emp_no, emp_name, password_hash, salt, must_change_password, status, page_permissions, remark, enabled) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{empName}, #{passwordHash}, #{salt}, #{mustChangePassword}, #{status}, #{pagePermissions}, #{remark}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_admin_user SET last_login_at = #{ts} WHERE id = #{id}
